attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a single RabbitMQ 4.3.5 cluster (CentOS Stream 10, Erlang 27.3.4.16), created a payments vhost with a durable quorum queue "orders" and an application account (app_payments) with full permissions on that vhost. Verified messages published to the durable quorum queue survive the loss of any one node and remain consumable from the remaining nodes. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: rebooted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially (one at a time, preserving quorum), proved each node's boot_id changed, and verified RabbitMQ service, cluster membership, and quorum queue health/pub-sub recovered after each restart.
